items.claim: Content script's run-once mark stops it re-injecting after a Chrome extension reload
wakeTab stops injecting once any frame answers, so other frames never get bridged
items.note: It now injects every frame each time. The manifest content script also gets `match_about_blank: true`, which covers A's about:blank/srcdoc case.

items.claim: A tab closed within 3 s of loading stays in the badge probe map, and a badge write on a closed tab is an unhandled rejection
items.note: My test for the rejection on the `loading` clear did not fail on the old code, so I dropped it. That path is fixed but has no test.

items.claim: watchHookPresence with an empty `delays` probes in a tight loop
items.note: I made the strict call: it now throws a RangeError, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: probeFrame trusts `roots()` to return an array, so the count can be NaN
Each panel remount reuses request ids on the shared transport, so a late answer settles the wrong request
items.note: The transport now gives requests ids that stay unique for its lifetime, maps answers back, and drops answers from before the latest `yo`.
